author: Goodnighht
body:
I've wanted a map similar to the original walls map "The Walls" for a long time. So I started making a map similar to it. These are a few pictures, I want it to be a good map for enchanting. There's 2 mines ATM, One is a very small ravine, the other is just a normal-ish cave.

Download: https://www.dropbox.com/sh/znjhx3b81336dsq/AAAo8xi85bQs212y7_gDyweoa?dl=0

Pictures: http://imgur.com/WcUnyoB,J6N5Zrn,V9uYcym,qgcenKf,RSykfkH

Things to do/done:

-There are NO chests(aside from middle chests and chest for looks), I wanted it to be like the old days. You have to work to get everything. ;)

-There will be an enchantment table, along with an anvil. As I said, I want it to be a 'OP' map, I like the idea of enchanting, getting protection 2, sharp 2, etc..

-Planning on adding more Iron, coal, and gold. There's not a whole lot right now. I will be adding more in the future.

Ideas that I need help deciding on:

-Food source. What should I do for that?

-Diamonds. For now I have no diamonds. Should I add some? Or leave it at iron, diamond may be too OP.

-Anything else you guys/girls notice.

Thanks! -Micahb222000

title: {Roots} {Walls}

replies.author: jracer15
replies.body:
Well it seems your map isn't all the way complete.  I would just make a wheat farm, and pretty large one so its not like theres no food like the Jungles maps.  Idk the map seems maybe too basic like you just added some tree and theres your map.  I would like to see a walls map similar to Hypixel's map so I like the idea that your putting out.

P.S. I would call it "Roots" because its taking the roots back to minecraft :)
